QuestInfo.name: [Fantasy Theme World] Find the Cardiotachometer
QuestInfo.0: Talk to #bDylan#k at Extreme Station <2> to help him find #bDelilah's#k ribbon brooch.
QuestInfo.1: #bDylan#k is tracking #bDelilah's#k ribbon brooch location with the cardiotachometer monitor, but Colabears are interfering. Defeat 150 Colabears in the area.
QuestInfo.2: #bDylan#k was tracking #bDelilah's#k ribbon brooch location with the cardiotachometer monitor, but Colabears were interfering. You defeated 150 Colabears in Extreme Station <2>.

1.msg: #b(You're starting to wonder if finding this thing is even a good idea.)#k

2.msg: Oh! I know how we can find it quickly! The sensor has a tracking device. We can use that and find it in no time at all! I'll turn on the GPS.

3.msg: Ah ha! Getting all the bells and whistles on this thing turned out to be worth it.\r\n#eJust, uh, take care of those monsters, so I can concentrate, would you?

0.msg: Thanks. It might be a bit of a challenge, but I'm sure you're up to the task. Right, new best bud?

no.0: I can't concentrate with all these monsters hanging around!

1.0: Yum! Get a whiff of that popcorn chicken! #e#h0##n, it looks like the monsters you defeated had popcorn chicken. It's no wonder I was distracted. That smells positively wonderful!

yes.0: I got a lock on the sensor's location! There's a strong signal coming from #bExtreme Station <3>#k. I'll wait for you there!

default.0: I'm still searching for the signal. Those monsters are really distracting. Think you can get rid of them for me?
